annotation.coordinate_frame: Original imported mesh rest coordinates. Named skin bind + global rest + skeleton ancestor evaluate the body back into this model frame (not native skeleton axes). Left/right follows nearest named ankle MODEL X, not raw positive-X convention.
annotation.coverage_boundary: Native front/back/side and oblique views locate the leather cuff around source/model-rest y=0.23 m. Retain every original face with ANY vertex below y=0.30 m; crossing/upper faces above y=0.22 m are separately labelled conservative cuff/adjacent-leg margin. All other body faces retain explicit exclusion. No weight threshold.
annotation.freeze_status: Implementation labels fixed for independent Review; no contact-error ranking was used. Any anatomical revision requires an explicit new annotation/freeze and preserves this version.
annotation.label_authority: Implementation anatomical annotation, to be checked against native underside/side/heel/toe views by the sole independent Review before acceptance.

legacy_diagnostics.authority: Original CERT diagnostic only; not promoted to complete support.
Original CERT diagnostic only; not promoted to complete support.

reasons.excluded.body: Body/trouser geometry entirely above the conservative boot/cuff enclosure (every source-rest vertex >= y=0.30 m); native front/back/side views place the leather boot cuff near y=0.23 m.
reasons.excluded.equipment: Separate bow, arrow or quiver surface; not footwear.
reasons.left.coverage_margin: Included upper cuff/buckle and adjacent lower-trouser margin: any face reaching above y=0.22 m while at least one source-rest vertex is below y=0.30 m. This is deliberately conservative collision coverage, not an assertion that trousers are footwear.
reasons.left.outsole.heel: Fixed anatomical underside heel chart, labelled from source-rest shape before contact-error ranking. Lower leather below visible sole rim; downward-facing facets retained including mixed weights. Longitudinal chart boundaries use named rest ankle/toe locations; no contact tolerance is implied.
reasons.left.outsole.midsole: Fixed anatomical underside midsole chart, labelled from source-rest shape before contact-error ranking. Lower leather below visible sole rim; downward-facing facets retained including mixed weights. Longitudinal chart boundaries use named rest ankle/toe locations; no contact tolerance is implied.
reasons.left.outsole.toe: Fixed anatomical underside toe chart, labelled from source-rest shape before contact-error ranking. reasons.left.upper_sidewall_shaft: Complete included footwear above/beside the bottom leather: upper, toe cap, heel counter, sidewall and boot shaft; collision domain, not a declared support chart.
reasons.right.coverage_margin: Included upper cuff/buckle and adjacent lower-trouser margin: any face reaching above y=0.22 m while at least one source-rest vertex is below y=0.30 m. This is deliberately conservative collision coverage, not an assertion that trousers are footwear.

annotation.rejected_draft: Initial mesh-axis assumption reversed both foot names and heel/toe. Native images exposed it before label freeze or contact error ranking. Rejected labelled frames remain preserved separately.
annotation.selection_order: Native textured six-angle views and complete original topology first; corrected named-bone model frames; refined conservative cuff enclosure from those views; fixed labels/charts frozen BEFORE any contact-error ranking.
annotation.support_annotation: Pre-error bottom-leather selection retains all facets whose source-rest vertices are below y=0.03 m and clockwise geometric normal points toward -Y. Heel is behind the named ankle plane, toe is beyond the named toe plane, midsole between, along each projected ankle-to-toe MODEL direction. These are anatomical partition boundaries, never physical budgets. All other footwear is retained in collision coverage.

capture_runs.scope: raw rest and regular MARCH frames only; rejected first annotation overlays excluded

atlas.derivation: Only contact-sheet scaling/captions and separately hash-bound unaltered 3x nearest-neighbour crops; original full native windows remain available at pinned paths.

failed_candidates_preserved.note: Those superseded overlays are preserved, never included as accepted final labels. Raw rest/MARCH frames from the initial run remain valid and hash-checked.

review_gate.rule: The artifact does not self-authorize anatomy. The unique Review independently checks full underside, sides, heel, toe, seam/boundary and margin coverage before acceptance.

authority: Fixed barycentric combinations of skinned vertices; all original influence bytes retained without normalization. No remeshing, welding, lowest-point reselection or weight cutoff.

canonical_support.kind: canonical author eight-step INTENT, kept separate from observed raw MARCH support
canonical_support.physical_authority: The author holds sole/toe frames. That intent does not establish physical whole-chart contact. These fixed planar diagnostic anchors do not supply actual terrain anchors or a contact budget; E2 must bind actual placement/terrain separately.
canonical_support.reference_phase_law: At phase 0 use march_entry_phase; at 1 use march_exit_phase; inside use (entry + ((exit-entry) mod 1)*phase) mod 1. Canonical cases have entry=exit=0. No arbitrary P1 phase extrapolation.

limitations: Material mode only. No actual terrain placement/window/FPS/clock calibration (E2), no solver/consumer/scene/policy edits.
Footwear collision enclosure includes complete boot exteriors and explicitly labelled conservative cuff/adjacent-trouser margin; not an assertion that trousers are footwear.
Support charts are fixed positive-area anatomical underside material domains, NOT accepted continuously load-bearing patches. Anatomical acceptance belongs to the unique Review.
Canonical frame support intent does not make every weighted material point stationary or contacting. Fixed model-plane anchors are diagnostic only; actual terrain anchors remain E2.
Finite MARCH views and transfer brackets do not certify continuous support, zero penetration, numerical enclosures, or arbitrary P1 entry/exit phases.

Areas/normals are finite arithmetic evaluations using captured float inputs and native Vector3/Transform3D operations. Packed f64 columns preserve reported values, not conservative arithmetic/GPU error bounds.
No clearance/penetration/slip/material-error allowance or D2/CERT PASS is inferred. Original failed CERT and all sixteen witnesses remain failed/protected provenance.

observed_native_march.bracket_authority: Every physical phase_bracket is null with bound_status=unbounded. finite_sample_envelopes index inspected morphology plus guard queries and bind both endpoints to recorded native times and paired original image SHA256; they are NOT physical event-time brackets. No clearance threshold, stance relabelling, interpolated transition or positive physical allowance is introduced.
observed_native_march.endpoints: Retain exact phase 0 and phase 1 native seeks and a finite phase 0.999999 left sample from both sides. One-sided limits and continuous interval support remain unbounded; no loop continuity certificate.
observed_native_march.fixed_label_rule: Canonical intended stance intervals remain unchanged INTENT even if their material charts fail contact. Exact finite observations describe heel/toe inclination or a near-parallel/oblique profile, never a premature broad-sole-low or swing state. They do not relabel or relax canonical stance.
observed_native_march.float32_pose_binding: All 64 regular rendered MARCH global matrices match original CERT capture float32 bits; decimal JSON printing residual is not a contact uncertainty bound.
observed_native_march.kind: Raw native MARCH morphology observations over the complete cycle, separate from canonical pivot support INTENT.
